plugins.name: no-co-authored
plugins.description: Blocks git commits whose message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer or the Claude Code footer, asking Claude to recreate the message without them.

plugins.name: git-sign-key
plugins.description: Signs git commits with a ~/.claude/sign.key file via SSH signing instead of the ssh-agent.

plugins.name: cctools-edit
plugins.description: Installs the cc-tools binary for the host OS and routes Read/Write/Edit/MultiEdit through it so file encodings (Latin-1/Windows-1252/UTF-8) are preserved instead of corrupted.

plugins.name: branch-management
plugins.description: Branch lifecycle skills backed by subagents: new-branch cuts a fresh branch; new-pr runs iterative parallel review rounds (claude/codex/copilot/coderabbit reviewers), applies verified fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green. Optionally refreshes a graphify output folder on new-branch and before the PR push (separate commit). Script execution and heavy output processing run through the context-mode plugin (declared cross-marketplace dependency).
